method: imagegen right-facing counterparts of approved left r1 whole poses; whole-pose registration only during packaging
sideConvention: view-local phases match left r1: near RIGHT in right-facing view; near LEFT in left-facing view; anatomical limb mapping changes

initial.prompt: Create the matching RIGHT-FACING NEUTRAL IDLE counterpart of the FIRST approved LEFT-facing P1 sprite. The FIRST image is the definitive character MODEL and quality reference; the SECOND old right-view image is only a facing/camera reference, do not copy its inferior proportions. Same exact boy, tousled chestnut hair, blue eye, head/body proportions, blue scarf and short blue coat with cream/gold trim, cream shirt, brown belt/gloves/side pouch, charcoal knee-length trousers, FULL folded-cuff brown laced leather boots. Turn the whole character to face SCREEN RIGHT at the same slightly elevated RPG near-side camera. Keep the same silhouette scale, head size relative to torso, trouser length, boot cuff/shaft height, heel thickness and toe length as the approved left sprite. The two directions must look like one coherent animation character, no redesign or aging. Scarf trails behind toward SCREEN LEFT, pouch sits behind belt at screen left as in old right camera reference. Crisp detailed pixel-sprite rendering and same colors, not painterly or blurry. Boots' toe boxes BOTH point screen RIGHT, natural hip-width stance, planted soles on common ground line, no outward splay. Arms relaxed, body upright. EXACTLY ONE full-body character, generous transparent margin, fully transparent background, no halo/aura/glow/ground/shadow/text/labels/sheet.

Redraw the FIRST approved LEFT-facing walking pose as the matching RIGHT-facing counterpart. FIRST IMAGE defines the EXACT gait phase, stride length, knee bend, boot dimensions, arm swing amplitude, body/head proportions and pixel-art quality. SECOND image is the new matching RIGHT IDLE model, for facing and costume, NOT the walking pose. The pair must look like ONE COORDINATED left/right game animation character. Same exact brown-haired blue-eyed boy, royal blue scarf/cream-gold trimmed coat, cream shirt, belt/gloves/pouch, charcoal knee-length trousers, FULL folded-cuff laced brown boots. Face SCREEN RIGHT at same slightly elevated near-side RPG camera, no diagonal/front/head turn. Scarf trails to SCREEN LEFT; brown pouch stays behind hip at screen left in this view. Preserve the first pose's body proportions, head size, normal short stride, boot cuff height/shaft/heel/toe length. Both toe boxes point SCREEN RIGHT in EVERY phase, even trailing raised boot. No outward splay, no boot flipping to screen left, no twisted ankles, no shoe shrink/stretch. Draw actual connected thigh-knee-shin-ankle-boot anatomy and near/far occlusion. Walking is not running or marching. Match FIRST pose timing/gesture precisely after changing facing. Near RIGHT leg/arm are closest to viewer in the RIGHT-facing view; FAR left leg/arm behind. Near sleeve is the large visible shoulder on screen LEFT; control its swing as specified. Crisp detailed pixel sprite, ONE full body with transparent margin, no text/sheet/labels/ground/shadow/halo/aura.
POSE TO RETAIN:
01 CONTACT A: NEAR RIGHT leg advances to SCREEN RIGHT, heel contacting ground with toe gently lifted; FAR LEFT leg trails to SCREEN LEFT, heel rising while its RIGHT-directed toe still on ground. NEAR RIGHT arm swings BACK to screen LEFT, far arm forward to screen RIGHT. Same split-stride amplitude as first reference.

refinements.prompt: Make the RIGHT-FACING counterpart by HORIZONTALLY REFLECTING this COMPLETE approved LEFT-facing sprite. Preserve the EXACT pose silhouette, knee geometry, distance between the ankles, foot placement, arm swing, near/far leg overlap, near/far boot brightness and full boot proportions after reflection. Do NOT widen the stride or raise the knee higher. This must look like the SAME short walk seen in the opposite direction. Do NOT invent a new phase, revert to idle or swap foreground leg. Everything faces SCREEN RIGHT, including both toe boxes and the raised foot. Dark far leg remains dark; bright near leg remains bright. Preserve same head/body ratio, face/hair identity, detailed crisp pixel-sprite rendering, blue scarf/coat, belt/pouch and gloves. Whole character, generous transparent margin, transparent background, no text/ground/shadow/halo/glow. Phase 01 geometry must match reference after changing facing. The goal is a synchronized left/right counterpart, not a different walk.
